title: metric-sampler / Run comparison
description: One quantity per chart, one line per selected run (x: step). Reads the summaries, so a run shows up once its summaries cover it.

list.name: runs
list.label: Runs
list.query: SELECT run FROM metric_sampler.batches GROUP BY run ORDER BY max(ingested_at) DESC

list.name: capture_interval
list.label: capture_interval
list.query: SELECT greatest(max(capture_interval), 1) FROM metric_sampler.node_manifests WHERE run IN (${runs:singlequote})

list.name: component
list.label: Loss component
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metric FROM metric_sampler.summary_loss_components WHERE run IN (${runs:singlequote}) ORDER BY metric

list.name: spread_metric
list.label: Spread metric
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT metric FROM metric_sampler.summary_loss_spread WHERE run IN (${runs:singlequote}) ORDER BY metric

list.name: stream
list.label: Data stream
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT stream_name FROM metric_sampler.summary_stream_loss WHERE run IN (${runs:singlequote}) ORDER BY stream_name

list.name: layer
list.label: Layer (activations)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT layer FROM metric_sampler.summary_activation WHERE run IN (${runs:singlequote}) ORDER BY layer

list.name: point
list.label: Activation point
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT point FROM metric_sampler.summary_activation WHERE run IN (${runs:singlequote}) ORDER BY point

list.name: act_stat
list.label: Activation statistic
list.query: rms, mean, std, amax_max, amax_median, kurtosis, skewness, fp8_e4m3_headroom_log2, bf16_headroom_log2

list.name: moe_layer
list.label: Layer (experts)
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT layer FROM metric_sampler.summary_layer_load WHERE run IN (${runs:singlequote}) ORDER BY layer

panels.title: Loss per step (mean over ranks and microbatches)
panels.description: Mean loss of every step, one line per selected run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT measured.step AS step, ifNull(nullIf(measured.run_name, ''), 'No data') AS run_name, measured.value AS value FROM (WITH observed AS (SELECT step, run AS run_name, toFloat64(loss_mean) AS value FROM metric_sampler.summary_loss_step FINAL WHERE (exp, run) IN (SELECT exp, run FROM metric_sampler.batches WHERE run IN (${runs:singlequote}) GROUP BY exp, run) AND step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0) ORDER BY run_name, step SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0), marked AS (SELECT *, leadInFrame(step, 1, step) OVER (PARTITION BY run_name ORDER BY step ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS next_step FROM observed WHERE step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0)) SELECT step, run_name, value FROM marked UNION ALL SELECT step + 1 AS step, run_name, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS value FROM marked WHERE marked.next_step > marked.step + ${capture_interval} SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0) AS measured RIGHT JOIN (SELECT 1) AS present ON 1 ORDER BY step SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.title: Loss component ${component} (mean over ranks and microbatches)
panels.description: One loss component per step, one line per run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT measured.step AS step, ifNull(nullIf(measured.run_name, ''), 'No data') AS run_name, measured.value AS value FROM (WITH observed AS (SELECT step, run AS run_name, toFloat64(value) AS value FROM metric_sampler.summary_loss_components FINAL WHERE (exp, run) IN (SELECT exp, run FROM metric_sampler.batches WHERE run IN (${runs:singlequote}) GROUP BY exp, run) AND metric = ${component:sqlstring} AND step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0) ORDER BY run_name, step SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0), marked AS (SELECT *, leadInFrame(step, 1, step) OVER (PARTITION BY run_name ORDER BY step ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS next_step FROM observed WHERE step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0)) SELECT step, run_name, value FROM marked UNION ALL SELECT step + 1 AS step, run_name, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS value FROM marked WHERE marked.next_step > marked.step + ${capture_interval} SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0) AS measured RIGHT JOIN (SELECT 1) AS present ON 1 ORDER BY step SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT measured.step AS step, ifNull(nullIf(measured.run_name, ''), 'No data') AS run_name, measured.value AS value FROM (WITH observed AS (SELECT step, run AS run_name, toFloat64(mean) AS value FROM metric_sampler.summary_stream_loss FINAL WHERE (exp, run) IN (SELECT exp, run FROM metric_sampler.batches WHERE run IN (${runs:singlequote}) GROUP BY exp, run) AND stream_name = ${stream:sqlstring} AND step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0) ORDER BY run_name, step SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0), marked AS (SELECT *, leadInFrame(step, 1, step) OVER (PARTITION BY run_name ORDER BY step ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS next_step FROM observed WHERE step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0)) SELECT step, run_name, value FROM marked UNION ALL SELECT step + 1 AS step, run_name, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS value FROM marked WHERE marked.next_step > marked.step + ${capture_interval} SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0) AS measured RIGHT JOIN (SELECT 1) AS present ON 1 ORDER BY step SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.title: Global gradient norm (the clipping norm)
panels.description: Total gradient norm used for clipping, one value per step.

targets.rawSql: SELECT measured.step AS step, ifNull(nullIf(measured.run_name, ''), 'No data') AS run_name, measured.value AS value FROM (WITH observed AS (SELECT step, run AS run_name, toFloat64(any(clip_total_norm)) AS value FROM (SELECT * FROM metric_sampler.summary_grad_per_rank FINAL WHERE (exp, run) IN (SELECT exp, run FROM metric_sampler.batches WHERE run IN (${runs:singlequote}) GROUP BY exp, run) AND step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0)) GROUP BY step, run ORDER BY run_name, step SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0), marked AS (SELECT *, leadInFrame(step, 1, step) OVER (PARTITION BY run_name ORDER BY step ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS next_step FROM observed WHERE step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0)) SELECT step, run_name, value FROM marked UNION ALL SELECT step + 1 AS step, run_name, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS value FROM marked WHERE marked.next_step > marked.step + ${capture_interval} SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0) AS measured RIGHT JOIN (SELECT 1) AS present ON 1 ORDER BY step SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT measured.step AS step, ifNull(nullIf(measured.run_name, ''), 'No data') AS run_name, measured.value AS value FROM (WITH observed AS (SELECT step, run AS run_name, toFloat64(step_time_median) AS value FROM metric_sampler.summary_step_time FINAL WHERE (exp, run) IN (SELECT exp, run FROM metric_sampler.batches WHERE run IN (${runs:singlequote}) GROUP BY exp, run) AND step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0) ORDER BY run_name, step SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0), marked AS (SELECT *, leadInFrame(step, 1, step) OVER (PARTITION BY run_name ORDER BY step ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS next_step FROM observed WHERE step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0)) SELECT step, run_name, value FROM marked UNION ALL SELECT step + 1 AS step, run_name, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS value FROM marked WHERE marked.next_step > marked.step + ${capture_interval} SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0) AS measured RIGHT JOIN (SELECT 1) AS present ON 1 ORDER BY step SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1

panels.title: Activation ${act_stat}, layer ${layer}, point ${point}
panels.description: Activation statistic over every rank and microbatch of the step.

targets.rawSql: SELECT measured.step AS step, ifNull(nullIf(measured.run_name, ''), 'No data') AS run_name, measured.value AS value FROM (WITH observed AS (SELECT step, run AS run_name, toFloat64(${act_stat}) AS value FROM metric_sampler.summary_activation FINAL WHERE (exp, run) IN (SELECT exp, run FROM metric_sampler.batches WHERE run IN (${runs:singlequote}) GROUP BY exp, run) AND layer = toInt32OrNull(${layer:sqlstring}) AND point = '${point}' AND step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0) ORDER BY run_name, step SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0), marked AS (SELECT *, leadInFrame(step, 1, step) OVER (PARTITION BY run_name ORDER BY step ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS next_step FROM observed WHERE step BETWEEN ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_from:sqlstring}), 4294967295) AND ifNull(toUInt64OrNull(${step_to:sqlstring}), 0)) SELECT step, run_name, value FROM marked UNION ALL SELECT step + 1 AS step, run_name, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS value FROM marked WHERE marked.next_step > marked.step + ${capture_interval} SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 0) AS measured RIGHT JOIN (SELECT 1) AS present ON 1 ORDER BY step SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'hash', optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1
